title: Clean Water Wells for Bundelkhand
summary: Build six solar-powered wells delivering safe drinking water to 12,000 people and ending the daily walk for water.

title: Classrooms for Every Child
summary: Fund teachers, supplies, and three new classrooms so 600 children can continue their education year-round.

title: Emergency Meals for Families
summary: Provide nutritious food parcels to 3,500 families facing acute shortages after a prolonged drought.

title: Mobile Medical Clinics
summary: Equip two mobile clinics bringing checkups, vaccines, and maternal care to remote desert villages.

title: Digital Literacy for Rural Girls
summary: Provide laptops, internet connectivity, and basic computer science training to 1,200 underprivileged rural girls across government schools.

title: Rainwater Harvesting for Dry Villages
summary: Install community rainwater harvesting units and restore traditional stepwells to secure sustainable agricultural water for 500 dryland farmers.

title: Midday Meals for Street Children
summary: Deliver freshly prepared hot nutritious midday meals daily to 2,000 children living in slums and temporary street shelters.

title: Restoring Sight: Cataract Surgeries for Elders
summary: Sponsor safe, quick, and free intraocular lens cataract surgeries to restore vision for 800 elderly village citizens who cannot afford private care.

title: Mobile Dental & Oral Care Clinics
summary: Equip mobile vans with modern dental tools to provide free checkups, cleanings, extractions, and oral hygiene education to children in slum neighborhoods.

title: Science Lab Kits for Government Schools
summary: Distribute hands-on physics, chemistry, and biology kit boxes to 150 rural government schools, enabling active science experimentation for 15,000 children.

title: Community Lake & Wetland Restoration
summary: De-silt and ecologically restore community water reservoirs to recharge groundwater aquifers and provide drinking water sources for 15 villages.

title: Empowering Women via Community Kitchens
summary: Train women self-help groups to operate community kitchens that serve low-cost, wholesome hot meals to migrant laborers and marginalized elders.

title: Maternal & Child Nutritional Support
summary: Provide direct critical prenatal vitamins, iron supplements, and fortified nutrient mixes to 3,000 expectant mothers in remote tribal communities.

title: Learning Aids for Differently-Abled Children
summary: Distribute sensory kits, Braille teaching devices, and speech-assistive learning tablets to 600 special education students in low-income schools.
